stem.text: A wave has period $T$, wavelength $\lambda$ and amplitude $A$. The wave is shown on a graph of displacement $x$ against distance $d$.

A.alt: Sinusoidal graph with axes labelled x and d, with dimension markers labelled A and λ.

B.alt: Sinusoidal graph with axes labelled x and d, with dimension markers labelled A and T.

C.alt: Sinusoidal graph with axes labelled x and d, with dimension markers labelled T and A.

D.alt: Sinusoidal graph with axes labelled x and d, with dimension markers labelled λ and A.
